subtitle: Supply Chain Director, targeting Head of Procurement, Asia Pacific
target: Head of Procurement, Asia Pacific (full job description supplied)

summary.strong: Real, measurable supply chain results at a S$400 million business, and eight years of genuine regional procurement leadership.
summary.changed: Rewrote the profile to lead with procurement, moved the regional procurement role from a one-line mention to a full entry, and put numbers first in every bullet.
summary.needs_evidence: Recent regional (multi-country) procurement leadership, procurement digitalisation, and sustainability in sourcing.

hiring_manager_read.first_impression: A partial match: a capable Singapore supply chain director whose regional procurement depth, the core of this role, is not visible until page two.
hesitations: The original profile says 'results-driven supply chain professional' and never mentions procurement, the job's core.
The regional procurement role, his strongest evidence for this job, is compressed to one line at the bottom.
Current scope is Singapore and Malaysia; the role asks for Asia Pacific.
hiring_manager_read.shortlist_case: Eight years running regional category strategy across six markets, plus a recent supplier consolidation that cut material cost by 7%. That combination is exactly what this hiring manager is buying, once it is visible on page one.
hiring_manager_read.interview_probe: Expect questions on why his regional procurement experience ends in 2016, and what he has done with more than two countries since.

ratings.evidence: Opens with 'Results-driven supply chain professional with strong leadership skills.' No function, scale or contribution.
ratings.fix: Lead with procurement identity, scale and the strongest regional evidence.

ratings.evidence: Current role states team of 60 and the business size; the regional role omits spend and markets.
ratings.fix: State spend, markets and team for every role.

ratings.evidence: Supplier consolidation 140 to 55, 7% material cost reduction, inventory 52 to 38 days.
ratings.fix: Keep. Put the number first in each bullet.

ratings.evidence: Leads 60 people, but decisions and influence are described as duties.
ratings.fix: Show the decisions he made and who they persuaded.

ratings.evidence: Regional procurement (2008 to 2016) appears as one line: 'Procurement roles, 2005 to 2016'.
ratings.fix: Give the relevant earlier role a full entry and mention it in the profile.

ratings.evidence: Four pages; duties repeated across both Harbour Foods roles.
ratings.fix: Cut repetition to reach two to three pages.

ratings.evidence: Skills section lists 'Team player, strategic thinker, Microsoft Office'.
ratings.fix: Replace with named capabilities each backed by evidence.
